in_marathi.name: Parthipan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parthipan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Parthipan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Partha' meaning 'son of Arjuna' and 'pan' meaning 'thousands'. This name signifies a victorious warrior, who is the son of a great warrior and has the courage and strength to lead thousands of warriors to victory.
